'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Ryan Walter DS Fondor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Walter]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Fondor]]
* '''Username:''' RyanNCWA
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
